items.value:
Expel Hammer
You can expel someone for 2 floors!
You should use it either on the floor where you bought it
or on the floor you moved to, otherwise you will lose this purchase.
Some npcs cannot be expelled.

Refresh
Are you not satisfied with current set of items?
Ask Johnny, of course, to freshen up the store for some points!

Hammer
A universal and necessary thing!
You can use this to break through windows,
unlock doors, squish any character,
restart the fan or restart the Symbol Machine!

Wind Blower
Ever needed to just push something away?
Look no farther than the Wind Blower!

Mysterious Teleporter
Prototype stolen From Baldi's Lab, too unstable to use on yourself!
What happens if you throw it at someone?

Invisibility Potion
Allows you to turn invisible! Use it wisely!

Boxing Glove
Ever felt too weak to fight? Use the Boxing Gloves!
They'll allow you to punch through ANYTHING!

Ice Boots
Has Baldi cornered you? Accelerate with these boots
to push him away and avoid losing!
You are elusive while you use them.

Placeable Portal
Have you ever wanted to travel using teleportation?
Then this is for you! Use these magical portals
to create two connected portals for fast travel!
Everyone can use them, but they will not be destroyed!

Placeable Fan
Is the hallway too stuffy?
Just grab this powerful fan to blast out powerful air!
Remember that it does not last forever!

Teleportation Bomb
Carefully! Explosive!
Throw it on the ground to create a mysterious hole
that swallows everyone and teleports them to different places!
The bomb explodes in 3 seconds after landing!

Magic Clock
Have you always wanted to stop time? Use the power of this clock!
This mysterious item will help you hold back time for a few seconds!
But keep in mind that you only have 20 seconds!
While time is stopped, you cannot interact with any entity!

Inflatable Balloon
Allows you to avoid collisions with others,
but takes a couple of seconds to inflate! You can also intentionally pop the balloon!

Raw Chicken Leg
Everybody loves chicken!
You should consider giving it to people... after you will cook it!

Cooked Chicken Leg
Everybody loves chicken!
You should consider giving it to people...!

Dough
An important ingredient in baking!
Remember: treat food with care, do not step on it.
Or else The Principal of the Thing will give you a punishment!

Bread
This fresh bread loaf surely will fill you with energy and might even will make you faster!

Piece of Bread
This fresh bread loaf surely will fill you with energy and might even will make you faster!
